plugins.name: ai-employee-kit
plugins.description: Clean View hides the technical details behind a simple checklist above the prompt; Agent Dock splits each request across a team of helper agents and shows them working live.

plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: Turns a rough prompt into a clear one in a side pane, with up to three quick questions, before anything is sent.

plugins.name: work-report
plugins.description: A pane that shows the tasks Claude finished for you, the hours that likely saved, and what that time is worth.

plugins.name: mod-manager
plugins.description: A Mods side pane (also the ≡ Mods status-bar button and /mods): every installed mod with its icon, description and command, an On/Off switch that reaches every chat within 3 seconds for your own mods, an eye to hide a mod while it keeps working, Open for pane mods, and new mods appearing by themselves

plugins.name: cache-handoff
plugins.description: A Cache Clock card above the prompt (the hour the prompt cache stays warm, an always-visible Auto-warm switch with invisible pings, dollar estimates, a cold-send guard) and a Handoff: a Refresh banner past 250k or on a cold cache, a five-step progress card, and a ready card that starts a new chat from the saved handoff

plugins.name: replay-button
plugins.description: A Replay button in the status bar that opens Replay Theater's step-through of the last turn's file edits

plugins.name: filetree-button
plugins.description: A Files button in the status bar that shows or hides the filetree mod's file tree

plugins.name: inject-prompt
plugins.description: An Inject button in the status bar that opens your saved prompts, grouped by category and filterable by tag or search, and inserts the ones you pick at the cursor

plugins.name: git-review
plugins.description: A Git Review button that lists your GitLab merge requests by project and starts a full review of one in a new terminal: conflicts, worktree, pipelines and scans, Sonar, and the project's own code review

plugins.name: employee-control-panel
plugins.description: A Control Tools button in the status bar that opens a panel to switch the model and effort level for Claude and its subagents, with a live status line

plugins.name: chat-inventory
plugins.description: A side pane, In this chat, with live cards for the to-do list, the connectors and command-line tools called, the context files read, the skills, the subagents and the web pages this chat used; opened from the status bar or /inventory

plugins.name: jira-session-tracker
plugins.description: A ◷ Jira button and side pane that follow every Claude Code session on your machine, group unlinked work by folder, and link it to Jira tickets, create tickets, log time and move statuses, writing to Jira only after you confirm a preview

plugins.name: jira-team-dashboard
plugins.description: A ▦ Team button and pane for the team lead: what the team logged and moved in Jira each day, by team, developer, project and story, with gaps, stuck tickets, a Flutter split, trends, exports and a weekly digest; read-only

plugins.name: team-board
plugins.description: Team Board: ideas and tasks for your team in a private dashboard artifact plus Claude Code commands: who is on what, priorities, ETAs, notes, read-only Jira status and executive reports.
